clip-beat-08.reason: Withdrawn by visual QC (REGENERATE, blocking). The inverted-U standpipe is free-floating inside the shell and connects to nothing. The down-leg ends in the oil pool with its metering orifice (that detail is correct), but the other leg terminates in a blind capped stub in mid-shell. Both copper stubs pass through the shell wall near the top and open straight into the shell interior, so gas would go in the inlet and out the outlet without ever entering the U-tube. Forcing suction gas up over the standpipe so liquid drops out is the only mechanism this cutaway exists to teach, and it is not plumbed.
